items.title: For the better part of 20,000 centuries of human history, not much happened. We spent almost all of ...
items.content:
For the better part of 20,000 centuries of human history, not much happened. We spent almost all of those making slightly different variations of one tool, we only figured out the metal thing after 19,940 centuries.

And stuff really took off 2 centuries ago. That we can sort of keep up is amazing.
